note: Lee County Conservation park on a 9-acre lake N of Keokuk. Campground sits up the slope back from the lake (wooded buffer), so not on the water. --Claude
summary: Low 26 -> 15 ($15 walk-up sites a 23-ft rig fits at 45-55 ft long), high 26, $4 fee; count 24 -> 23; season 04-15 to 10-31; min 2 weekend/3 holiday added; hookups and facilities confirmed. Not waterfront stands; pin fine.
flags: WATERFRONT: not waterfront stands. Imagery: the campground's loops are about 120 m from the 9-acre lake through continuous forest. A second gravel loop reaches about 55 m from the lake's south arm, and shows no pads; nothing on the county's pages places sites there.
PIN: stored point is in the woods about 140 m ESE of the loops (centre about 40.4382,-91.4564). Under the 250 m bound; no re-pin needed.

FEE LOW: the $15 walk-ups are 14 ft wide with no electricity. Walk-ups count as the base under the 'cheapest site a 23-ft motorhome fits' rule, and earlier Lee County entries use the walk-up price as low the same way.
